item.title: NGINX2Root: F5 patches five critical NGINX vulnerabilities
item.description: F5 has patched five critical vulnerabilities in NGINX, the world’s most widely used open-source web server, that can allow remote code execution under certain conditions. Dubbed “NGINX2Root” by Xint researchers, two of the bunch (CVE-2026-123633 and CVE-2026-123007) were also independently unearthed and reported by Rapid7, Wiz, Ikotas Labs, Palo Alto Networks and Metnir researchers.
